timeline.description: In Coimbatore, a tragic incident unfolded as 16-year-old A Akilan, a Scheduled Caste student, took his own life allegedly due to persistent harassment from peers and a teacher over his dietary preferences. Authorities have initiated a case against the teacher, headmaster, and two students, inciting public protests for justice and a thorough investigation.

Among them were three Sri Lankan nationals and a woman from Tamil Nadu attempting to cross into Nepal through a forest route. Security personnel discovered that the passports of the Sri Lankans had expired three months earlier. Authorities are currently investigating their travel circumstances and intended destination.

Isabel Rossi's six-month research project showed that adding just five sensors could increase simulated detection coverage by 16.7%. She used earthquake records from California and mathematical methods to identify better sensor locations.
